provider: CUHK BBA-JD Double Degree Programme current Study Sequence
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter; reviewed on 2026-08-24
note: The official current Study Sequence applies to students admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter and publishes 38 unique Programme-local code-title entries across Years 1-5, including LAWS6089 as the explicit alternative to LAWS6006 and both LAWS6901/LAWS6902 research alternatives. The downloaded 107,909-byte HTML snapshot had SHA-256 b82a135017cb3b854d453a27ca86a1e0cddeede52ff6574cf291877b73b72d27. The page states that the DSME subject-area code changed to DOTE from 2024-25, so the five bracketed DOTE[DSME] rows use the current DOTE codes while retaining the legacy-code evidence in their group labels. The complete visually reviewed eight-page 2026 brochure was 16,630,823 bytes with SHA-256 5c3d8beb75ee59dea5e6105df694d97dfd572fdfd62c50316d7a537f914db606 and confirms the 172-unit five-year structure. The annual totals include unnamed University Core courses and variable BBA/LAWS elective slots, and neither source publishes per-course units or the closed elective pools. The six undergraduate LAWS courses also exempt LAWS6001, LAWS6021 and LAWS6023 in the JD phase, while Year 4 progression requirements remain external. Therefore all 38 coded entries keep credits=0 as unknown and the Programme remains browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage.
